prompt.project_info: Create a realistic smartphone portrait in a lush sunlit rose garden.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long loose golden-blonde waves, natural makeup, fair skin with real pores, and a soft warm closed-lip smile, wearing a cream opaque ribbed long-sleeve top and light-blue mid-rise denim jeans.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered 3:4 mid-length portrait from upper thighs to head, slight forward lean with hands behind back, flowering rose bushes, garden foliage, gentle breeze, and recognizable but softened background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural soft daylight with sun-kissed highlights and open-shade shadows, calm affectionate garden atmosphere, mild smartphone sharpening and subtle sensor noise.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic smartphone portrait, eye-level with slight downward tilt, moderate depth of field, crisp natural detail, no mirror or reflection artifacts.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic 3:4 smartphone portrait of an approved adult woman with long loose golden-blonde waves, center part, face-framing strands, natural makeup, fair skin with real pores, and a soft warm closed-lip smile. She wears a cream opaque ribbed long-sleeve top with a secure neckline and light-blue mid-rise denim jeans. She stands in front of flowering rose bushes, leaning slightly forward with shoulders relaxed and hands behind her back, head gently tilted. A light breeze moves a few flyaways. Use soft natural daylight, sun-kissed highlights, open-shade shadows, a lush recognizable rose garden, moderate depth of field, crisp natural detail, mild smartphone sharpening, and subtle sensor noise.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, cropped top, low-rise jeans, exposed midriff, deep neckline, flirtatious sexualized expression, body-part emphasis, nudity, mirror artifacts, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hair, rose garden, cream-blue palette, gentle pose, and sunlight; replace wardrobe with equally opaque casual alternatives. Keep typography absent and no mirror rules apply.

changes: Clarified approved adult and replaced cropped top, low-rise fit, exposed midriff, and flirtatious wording with secure coverage and a warm friendly smile.
